sections.title: General Conduct
sections.body:
Chairs is currently invite-only and will eventually transition to a community-vouched model. We are selective about who joins, and members should not publicly advertise, promote, or share access to the server without approval. The value of this community comes from the people in it, not the size of it.

Don't be a dick, fucktard, or dumbass.
No DOC judgement as long as you follow rule 1
Be respectful. Different opinions, backgrounds, and senses of humor are welcome. Cruelty isn't.
Read the room. Not every channel or voice call is the place for every joke or topic. Pay attention to the vibe before you speak.
Keep it responsible. We're here for good times, not chaos. Have fun, but don't be the reason the night goes sideways.
No drama. If there's beef between members, take it to DMs or drop it entirely. This isn't the place to air grievances or start a scene.
Respect the vibe. Chairs is small and vetted on purpose.
Everyone here got a seat because someone vouched for them.
Treat that trust with respect. This isn't a public server, so act like a guest who wants to be invited back.
No hate speech, harassment, or bigotry. Zero tolerance, no warnings needed.
Keep NSFW content out of general spaces.

sections.title: Voice Channels
sections.body:
All the above still applies. A voice call isn't a loophole.
Don't steamroll conversations. Let people finish their thoughts.
Please check with the group before introducing traumatic topics.
Don't talk over others or dominate every discussion
No mic spamming, soundboards, or blasting audio
Use on cam is allowed (no needles or IV)
Step out if you need to cool off.
Mute your mic if you have background noise.
No lurking for extended periods.

sections.title: Enforcement
sections.body:
1st    Warning / Timeout
2nd    VC ban or channel restriction
3rd    Server removal
